profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: A seasoned and versatile software engineer with over eighteen years of experience in design/implement and provide support for web based enterprise system. Core skills include Java Enterprise Eco-system (EJB, JSF, JPA, JAXB, JAXWS,..) and Spring Framework components (Spring Boot, Spring Core, Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring-WS). Familiar front end technologies include HTML/CSS, Javascript libaries (JQuery, Extjs), and component based JSF/Primefaces. Automated testing frameworks/tools include JUnit, Spring Integration, Selenium. Experience in working with various development environments and tools such as Groovy Grails or Eclipse based IDEs. Experience in software designs using UML diagrams.

projects.title: BootForum2
projects.description:
A prompt engineering project implementating a web forum/discussion application. AI assistants used include Google Gemini and ChatGPT.
The project uses a modern technology stack that includes Spring Boot 3 / Hibernate 6 for back end. Angular 19, PrimeNG 19, and Tailwind CSS 4 for the front end.

projects.title: BootForum
projects.description:
Full features web based forum/disscussion/bulletin board software implemented using Java, Spring Boot, Eclipselink, Primefaces, and W3.CSS.

Cross-platform supported. All platforms that run Java: Unix/Linux, Windows, or Mac OS.
Support all relational databases that provide JDBC connectivity. Tested on Postgresql, H2, MySQL, SQL Server, and Oracle.
Responsive web designed using W3.CSS framework to display and function well on all screen sizes (desktop, tablet, or mobile phone)
Very easy to operate: run out of the box with minimal configuration. Run-time configuration flexibilty enabled by Spring Boot.

Code repository:
https://github.com/chipolaris/BootForum

Live Demo:
http://www.softunify.com:8080/BootForum/index.xhtml
